cold.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether a vitamin C supplement is suitable for you.
cold.cautions: High amounts can cause stomach upset. Ask a pharmacist if you take other medicines or have kidney stones.
cold.commonly_used_for: A vitamin supplement that some people take for general immune support. It does not cure a cold.
cold.name: Vitamin C

cold.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether zinc lozenges are suitable for you.
cold.cautions: Can cause nausea or a bad taste. Do not use zinc nasal products unless a pharmacist advises it. Ask a pharmacist if you are pregnant or take other medicines.
cold.commonly_used_for: Lozenges that some people use for cold symptoms. Evidence is mixed and they do not cure a cold.
cold.name: Zinc lozenges

headache.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether this is suitable for you, and what dose, if any, is right for you.
headache.cautions: Check the label for liver warnings. Do not take more than the label allows, and check other products you take so you do not double up. Ask a pharmacist if you have liver problems, drink alcohol regularly, are pregnant, or take other medicines.
headache.commonly_used_for: General pain relief, including headache, when used as directed on the product label.
headache.name: Paracetamol / acetaminophen

headache.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether this is suitable for you, especially if you take other medicines or have stomach, kidney, or heart conditions.
headache.cautions: Can irritate the stomach and affect kidneys and blood pressure. Use caution if you have asthma, stomach ulcers, kidney or heart problems, take blood thinners, or are pregnant. Take with food if the label advises it.
headache.commonly_used_for: General pain relief and inflammation, including some headaches, when used as directed on the product label.
headache.name: Ibuprofen

headache.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether a magnesium supplement is worth discussing, and what form and amount, if any, a clinician would suggest.
headache.cautions: Can cause loose stools. Ask a pharmacist if you have kidney problems, take other medicines, or are pregnant.
headache.commonly_used_for: A mineral supplement that some people discuss with clinicians for general headache support. Evidence varies and it is not a treatment on its own.
headache.name: Magnesium

headache.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether riboflavin is worth discussing with a clinician for your situation.
headache.cautions: Generally well tolerated, but ask a pharmacist if you take other medicines or have a medical condition, and if you are pregnant.
headache.commonly_used_for: A B vitamin that some people discuss with clinicians for general headache support. Evidence varies and it is not a treatment on its own.
headache.name: Riboflavin (vitamin B2)

headache.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether coenzyme Q10 interacts with any medicine you already take.
headache.cautions: Can interact with blood thinners and blood pressure medicines. Ask a pharmacist before starting it, especially if you take other medicines.
headache.commonly_used_for: A supplement that some people discuss with clinicians for general headache support. Evidence varies and it is not a treatment on its own.
headache.name: Coenzyme Q10

sore throat.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether soothing drinks are enough, or whether you need to be seen.
sore throat.cautions: Do not give honey to children under 1 year old. Ask a pharmacist if you have diabetes or take other medicines.
sore throat.commonly_used_for: A traditional soothing drink for a sore throat. It is a comfort measure, not a medicine.
sore throat.name: Honey and lemon (in warm water)

tiredness.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether iron testing or review is needed, rather than starting a supplement.
tiredness.cautions: Do not start iron on your own. Too much iron can be harmful, and it can interact with other medicines. Ask a doctor first.
tiredness.commonly_used_for: Iron is sometimes discussed when tiredness is linked to low iron, but only after testing and clinician advice.
tiredness.name: Iron (only if a clinician advises it)

tiredness.ask_pharmacist_about: Whether vitamin D is worth discussing with a clinician for your situation.
tiredness.cautions: High amounts can be harmful. Ask a pharmacist if you take other medicines or have kidney problems.
tiredness.commonly_used_for: A vitamin supplement that some people discuss with clinicians for general health, especially with limited sun exposure.
tiredness.name: Vitamin D
